Hi Elena,

Thanks for the request — attaching a short bundle for procurement review and answering your questions below.

Attachments (attached to this email):
- SOC2_Roadmap_2025.pdf (redacted SOC 2 Type II report summary and audit window)
- CAIQ_snapshot_2026.xlsx (completed CAIQ/controls mapping for common SIG items)
- redwood-vpc-network-diagram.png (logical diagram showing Dedicated vs. Private deployment options)

Short answers:
- EU-only processing: We offer a contractual data residency option for our Enterprise customers. The standard approach for MedSecure pilot would be: data processed in EU-only model (primary region eu-west-1 / eu-central-1), contractual clause in the DPA with SCCs and an explicit data flow restriction. For customers requiring absolute geographic egress prohibitions, we offer Redwood Private as a VPC-deployed control plane within customer VPCs (Azure/AWS/GCP).

- Technical enforcement: routing policies + regional placement of compute, strict key management (customer-managed KMS available), and audit logs showing data processed in EU regions only. We can provide a processing locations export for a time-bound window to support your DPIA.

- VPC options: three possible patterns:
  1) Redwood Dedicated (isolated GPU pools in our tenant, EU-only regions) — fastest to stand up, contractual data residency
  2) Private VPC deployment (on-prem or VPC in your tenant) — highest isolation, we ship an on-prem package or deploy into customer-managed cloud (requires infra team coordination, estimated 6-8 weeks)
  3) VPN/peering to our private deployment (IPsec or AWS/VNet peer) — middle ground, typical lead time 3-4 weeks for network configuration and customer firewall changes

- DPIA / DPA / SCCs: Legal can provide a DPA addendum and standard SCC text. For high-sensitivity customers we accept negotiation of narrow exceptions.

We will not export raw customer data to non-EU regions under an EU-only residency contract; subprocessor list and last processed date ranges are in the CAIQ snapshot.

If helpful, Vivek can host a short technical deep-dive for your infra/security team this week to walk the network diagram and key controls.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Monica, that is helpful. A couple follow-ups:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood will sign the standard SCCs without modification for the pilot? We prefer standard SCCs + DPA addendum; redlines may delay the SOW.
- For the Private VPC option, will Redwood run any managed services within our tenant or do you require a brokered account? We need clarity for procurement budget and network ACLs.
- Do you have an example attestation we can place in our DPIA that confirms processing locations and subprocessors for the last 12 months?

If you can provide a short attestation letter and indicate an approximate procurement timeline for each VPC option (Dedicated / Private / Peering), we can map to our SOW dates.

Regards,
Elena
